text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Is this about... how I ran in 
yesterday's mock race? Ahaha, you noticed, 
didn't you? As expected of you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I threw a shoe right after 
the start. But hey, that can happen in an 
actual race too, so I thought, 'Might as 
well keep going!' ...haha.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
At first, I couldn't dig in properly 
around the corners, so I wasn't sure how 
it'd go, but—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I shifted my center of gravity and gave it 
a big push, and it felt great. It felt a 
bit different from usual, but I just 
rolled with it♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even if the distance increases, even if a 
horseshoe comes off. There's no reason it 
can't be overcome. Because—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Before me, everything is a mile! If the 
stage is set for me, there's nothing I 
cannot achieve!
